---
title: "create hashing"
output: html_document
date: "2026-11-24"
---

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(digest)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(seqinr)
```

load ASV tables 
```{r}
skq23 <- read.csv(here("output/SKQ2023/seqtab.csv"))
skq24 <- read.csv(here("output/SKQ2024/seqtab.csv"))
```

generate hash keys - skq2023
```{r}
# Extract ASV sequences from column names
Sequences <- colnames(skq23)[-1]

# Generate SHA1 hashes
Hashes <- map_chr(Sequences, ~ digest(.x, algo = "sha1", serialize = FALSE))

# Create conversion table
conv_table <- tibble(Hash = Hashes, Sequence = Sequences)

# Save conversion table
write.csv(conv_table, here("output/SKQ2023/conv_file.csv"))

# Export FASTA file
write.fasta(sequences = as.list(conv_table$Sequence), names = as.list(conv_table$Hash), file.out = here("output/SKQ2023/conv_file.fasta"))
```

reshape and join hash keys to ASV table, export 
```{r}
sample.df <- skq23 %>%
  rename(Sample_name = X) %>%
  mutate(Label = "MV1") %>%
  relocate(Label, .after = Sample_name)

#pivot
current_asv <- sample.df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Sample_name, Label),
    names_to = "Sequence",
    values_to = "nReads") %>%
  filter(nReads > 0)

#join hash keys
current_asv <- current_asv %>%
  left_join(conv_table, by = "Sequence") %>%
  select(Sample_name, Label, Hash, nReads)

#export 
write_csv(current_asv, here("output/SKQ2023/hash_table.csv"))
```

create a single fasta file with hash keys 
```{r}
skq23_conv <- read.csv(here("output/SKQ2023/conv_file.csv")) %>% select(!X)
skq24_conv <- read.csv(here("output/SKQ2024/conv_file.csv")) %>% select(!X)

skq_conv <- skq23_conv %>%
  bind_rows(skq24_conv) %>%
  distinct()

nrow(skq23_conv) + nrow(skq24_conv) - nrow(skq_conv)

# Save conversion table
write.csv(skq_conv, here("output/combined/conv_file.csv"))

# Export FASTA file
write.fasta(sequences = as.list(skq_conv$Sequence), names = as.list(skq_conv$Hash), file.out = here("output/combined/conv_file.fasta"))
```
